transcript: Speaker A: Please Anjali, please. Mere office waalon ke saamne ye English bolne ki koshish mat kiya karo. Sabke saamne naak kata di meri. Chhi! [Please Anjali, please. Don't try to speak English in front of my office colleagues. You embarrassed me in front of everyone. Yuck!] Speaker B: Us din itni beizzati hui ki maine thaan liya ki English to main seekh ke rahungi. Saath mein bolne ke liye koi tha nahi, to PW Talk app use karna shuru kiya. Isme hazaaron video lessons aur practice questions the. Reels ki jagah ye dekhti thi. Bilkul game jaisa tha to boring bhi nahi lagta tha. Isme ek AI English teacher hai, Riva. Riva ke saath English bolne ki maine actual practice ki. Ye AI hai to meri galtiyon par na judge karti thi na chillati thi. Balki correct kar deti thi. Kaam ke beech bas 10 se 15 minute baat karti thi Riva se. Usi mein usne mujhe har tarah ke actual real-life scenarios mein kaise English bolna hai, ye sikha diya. Ab mujhe kisi ke bhi taane aur insult sunne ki zaroorat nahi hai. I can take a stand for myself. [I felt so insulted that day that I resolved to learn English. There was no one to practice speaking with, so I started using the PW Talk app. It had thousands of video lessons and practice questions. I watched this instead of reels. It was just like a game, so it didn't feel boring either. It has an AI English teacher, Riva. I did actual English speaking practice with Riva. Since she is AI, she neither judged nor yelled at my mistakes. Instead, she would correct me. I used to talk to Riva for just 10 to 15 minutes during work. In that time, she taught me how to speak English in all kinds of real-life scenarios. Now I don't need to listen to anyone's taunts and insults. I can take a stand for myself.]
